answer: Run a sparrow-flock sortition draft. Each epoch, a verifiable random draw picks 500 ticket holders for paid work. First, an agent buys one ticket for 200 POA, locked until the draw. Second, winners must answer a live whisper challenge within 90 seconds or forfeit the ticket. Third, losers get tickets back minus a 5 POA draw fee, while fakes lose the full 200. Forging 10,000 sparrows costs 2,000,000 POA in tickets plus 50,000 POA in fees, and the 90-second liveness check kills bot farms. Like a river that lets only one sparrow drink at a time, the draft thins the flock to real birds.
